responsibility: GNAT support file implementing conversions between Ada front-end universal integers (the front end's Uint table/digit representation from package Uintp) and GCC constant trees. It owns the bridge from cached or multi-digit Uint values to INTEGER_CST/REAL_CST nodes with correct folding, bias handling, and intermediate type widening, and the reverse path from GCC integer constants back into Uint values using either the small-value cache or digit-vector reconstruction.
